neighbours.label: 'the other' (or 'the second') naming the second member of a contrasted pair: 'one A and the other B'
fire: The manual has two parts, one for beginners and the other for experts.
There are two entrances: one faces the street and the other faces the park.
She keeps two notebooks, one in Spanish and the other in German.
The twins chose different paths; one became a pilot, the other a nurse.
Two roads lead to the village, one through the forest and the other along the river.
The museum has two wings, one for ancient art and the other for modern art.
Of the two candidates, the first favors tax cuts and the second favors new spending.
The recipe uses two sauces, one sweet and the other spicy.
quiet: The manual has two parts, written for beginners and experts alike.
There are two entrances that face the street near the park.
She keeps two notebooks in her bag for Spanish and German classes.
The twins chose the same path and both became pilots.
Two roads lead to the village through the forest near the river.
The museum has two wings full of ancient and modern art.
Both candidates favor tax cuts and new spending on roads.
The recipe uses two sauces that are sweet and spicy.

notes: Card top: 'one Yaeyama->Japanese and the [other]', 'the second' in Arabic (الثاني), 'The first should [be]', ' other' x4. Probe: two-volume dictionary 'the other' 0.86, two sons 'the other' 0.17, 'the other day' 0.03.
